shape.description: Analytic 2D SDF shape: circle or rounded box. Upstream default sphere3D/volumetric/shape JSON platform NOT_SUPPORTED.

scale.description: Uniform shape scale in the rotated field space.

turbulence.description: Depth of the flowing molten folds; 0 leaves the pure bevel normal.

ripple.description: Molten fold scale (multiplied by 2.6 in the shader); higher = smaller, busier ripples.

warp.description: Flow swirl (multiplied by 0.9); domain-warps the folds into liquid curls.

speed.description: Animated-time speed; 0 pauses flow and studio drift. Speed changes remap the phase (documented divergence from upstream accumulated Σdt·speed).

environment.description: Strength of the reflected three-softbox studio.

envRotation.description: Rotation of the studio frame around the surface.

sharpness.description: Specular tightness; 1 = razor chrome glints, 0 = soft satin.

dispersion.description: Prismatic fringing along reflection edges (chromatic split, high quality only).

lightAngle.description: Key-light direction for the specular glints (elevation fixed at −0.7).

bevelWidth.description: Edge bevel width (floored at 0.003 in the profile).

bevelShape.description: 0 = round fillet, 1 = machined chamfer profile with tangent breaks.

seed.description: Local extension: offsets the relief-noise domain. 0 is the fixed base domain.

quality.description: Quality tier — a REAL compute change: high runs the chromatic-split path with a second studio evaluation per pixel; low shares one studio evaluation across RGB. Algorithm/cost difference documented in UPSTREAM.md.
